They can create the same runes as [[rune essence]] as well as [[Cosmic rune|cosmic]], [[Chaos rune|chaos]], [[Astral rune|astral]], [[Nature rune|nature]], [[Law rune|law]], [[Death rune|death]], [[Blood rune|blood]], [[Wrath rune|wrath]], and any [[combination rune]]s. cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
[[File:Pure essence detail.png|left|120px]]
'''Pure essence''' is a raw material used in the [[Runecraft]] [[skill]] to make all types of [[runes]]. They can create the same runes as [[rune essence]] as well as [[Cosmic rune|cosmic]], [[Chaos rune|chaos]], [[Astral rune|astral]], [[Nature rune|nature]], [[Law rune|law]], [[Death rune|death]], [[Blood rune|blood]], [[Wrath rune|wrath]], and any [[combination rune]]s. Pure essence does not provide any bonus over rune essence when crafting runes lower than cosmic runes; they are however much cheaper.

Unlike runes, pure essence does not stack. [[Essence pouch]]es can be used to transport additional essence, when collecting or using pure essence to craft runes. Pure essence is one of the most commonly traded items in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]'', due to its very high demand by runecrafters.
secondaryExcerpts: Unlike runes, pure essence does not stack. [[Essence pouch]]es can be used to transport additional essence, when collecting or using pure essence to craft runes. Pure essence is one of the most commonly traded items in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]'', due to its very high demand by runecrafters.

[[Members]] with a [[Mining]] level of at least 30 will mine pure essence instead of [[rune essence]] (both granting 5 [[experience]]) on member worlds at the [[Rune essence mine]], after completing the [[Rune Mysteries]] quest. To access this mine, which contains four rocks with an unending supply of essence, players must get teleported by one of the five [[Rune essence mine#Teleportation and accessing the mine|NPCs who are able to do so]]. The speed at which essence is mined does not depend on the player's Mining level, but rather their pickaxe's tier.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1325832971455258624|date=9 November 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/102470|archivedate=10 September 2021|quote=The essence rock doesn't have a random roll based on your stat like other rocks do - it's like everyone gets a 100% chance at any level. But a better pickaxe can let you roll more frequently than a basic pickaxe.}} As such, this means every roll at mining essence will be successful.

It is possible for players with [[essence pouch]]es and a high level [[pickaxe]] to mine upwards of 2,100 pure essence an hour. If mining pure essence, players should consider taking [[weight-reducing clothing]], or [[energy-boosting items]] and the aforementioned essence pouches so that more pure essence can be mined per hour. The best place to mine essence is by going to [[Wizard Distentor]] who is located in the [[Wizards' Guild]] in [[Yanille]], but this requires 66 [[Magic]]. Players without this level should go for [[Aubury]] in [[Varrock]]. Members who have unlocked [[Guardians of the Rift]] may also use [[Archmage Sedridor]] at [[Wizards' Tower]], using the portal to bank at the minigame for a very short travel time. However, players can also go to [[Brimstail]] at [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]], [[Wizard Cromperty]] in [[Ardougne]], or the [[Lunar Isle mine]] if they so choose. However, these locations are not recommended, due to their comparatively long distances from [[bank]]s.

Pure essence can be purchased from [[Dom Onion's Reward Shop]] using points earned in the [[Nightmare Zone]] [[minigame]]. However, [[ironmen]] are restricted from buying it or any of the other resources available in the shop.

[[Ironmen]] who have completed [[In Aid of the Myreque]] and [[Darkness of Hallowvale]] may find [[Temple Trekking]] a good way of obtaining pure essence relatively early on, before options such as [[Zulrah]] or [[Gargoyle]]s are viable. By using easy NPCs and route one, most encounters are fairly fast or can be evaded, and each reward token gives 50+ essence. This can lead to approximately 3,000 essence per hour. As an alternative, stronger players can take easy NPCs through route 3, and are rewarded with approximately 600 essence per run, resulting in up to 8,000 essence per hour.

With partial completion of [[Desert Treasure II]], [[tainted essence chunk]]s can be mined from the [[Scar essence mine]] and converted into pure essence via the [[essence orifice]] at a rate of two chunks per 5 pure essence. This can yield up to 10,000 essence per hour.

When training Runecraft, pure essence is a common choice for the input resource. Because it is one of the only two [[tradeable]] [[Runecraft#Essence|essence]]s, and the only tradeable essence that can craft members-only runes, some players will trade with other players at the runic altars to increase the amount of runes they can craft per trip, extending to being able to permanently stay at the altar with a high enough trade frequency. This practice is called [[Pay-to-play Runecraft training#Using lava_runners|essence running]]. Essence running is allowed at all altars except at the [[Ourania Altar]], where trading is prohibited.

Using a mixture of daeyalt essence and [[pure essence]] in the same runecrafting trip will result in the daeyalt essence being used first; a second craft-runes action on the altar is required to then craft using the pure essence. Because of this, [[Achievement Diary]] tasks will fail unless you only use one type of essence.
